# The Eden Institute

> A structured, worldview-anchored, terrain-based clinical herbalism institute. The Eden Institute teaches constitutional (Biblical) herbalism, the practice of matching herbs to a person's unique body pattern rather than to isolated symptoms, grounded in Scripture and clinical rigor. We also publish Eden's Table, a Christ-centered K–12 homeschool herbalism curriculum.

## Core concepts
- [What Is Constitutional Herbalism?](https://edeninstitute.health/constitutional-herbalism): Constitutional (Biblical) herbalism matches herbs to the person, not the symptom. Covers the six tissue states (hot, cold, damp, dry, tense, relaxed), the Five Tenets of Health (Nutrition, Elimination, Rest, Hydration, Spiritual Alignment), and the Scriptural basis for terrain-based plant medicine.
- [Why Eden](https://edeninstitute.health/why-eden): The worldview, philosophy, and founding conviction behind the Institute: a Western, biblically anchored alternative to Eastern and New Age frameworks.

## Programs
- [Eden's Table: Homeschool Herbalism Curriculum](https://edeninstitute.health/homeschool): A Christ-centered K–12 homeschool curriculum teaching Biblical herbalism and the body God designed, with open-and-go weekly lessons. Week 1 is free for Sprouts (K–2) and Seedlings (3–5).
- [Sprouts Printed Curriculum Set](https://edeninstitute.health/books): All 36 weeks of Sprouts (K–2) in three printed books (Teacher's Guide, Student Notebook, Read-Aloud Storybook), $249 plus $12 shipping, printed to order and shipped in about two to three weeks.
- [Sprouts 9-Week Starter Unit](https://edeninstitute.health/starter): Weeks 1 to 9 of Sprouts as an instant digital download, $39.
- [Courses](https://edeninstitute.health/courses): The Eden Institute's three-tier clinical herbalism education program: Foundations, Body Systems & Clinical Literacy, and Clinical Application & Mentorship.
- [Free Body Pattern Assessment](https://edeninstitute.health/assessment): A short quiz that identifies your constitutional body pattern across the six tissue states.

## Scholarship and ESA families
- [Use your ESA or scholarship for Eden's Table](https://edeninstitute.health/esa): Eden's Table (Sprouts, grades K-2, Bible-based science and nature study) is an approved or registered vendor in seven education savings account and scholarship programs: Arizona ESA, Utah Fits All, Louisiana GATOR, Wyoming ESA, Arkansas EFA, Alabama CHOOSE Act and New Hampshire EFA. Each state page explains how buying works in that program right now, including where a marketplace listing is still pending.
- [Arizona ESA](https://edeninstitute.health/esa/arizona) · [Utah Fits All](https://edeninstitute.health/esa/utah) · [Louisiana GATOR](https://edeninstitute.health/esa/louisiana) · [Wyoming ESA](https://edeninstitute.health/esa/wyoming) · [Arkansas EFA](https://edeninstitute.health/esa/arkansas) · [Alabama CHOOSE Act](https://edeninstitute.health/esa/alabama) · [New Hampshire EFA](https://edeninstitute.health/esa/new-hampshire)

## Community
- [The Rooted Community](https://edeninstitute.health/community): A private network for homesteaders, homeschool families, and liberty-minded believers building lives connected to the land, the body, and each other.
